question: Who among the following got Padma Vibhushan Award 2022 under the civil service category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bipin Rawat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **General Bipin Rawat, India's first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)**, was posthumously awarded t**he Padma Vibhushan**.
 
• He died in a helicopter mishap in December 2021. On behalf of the CDS, his daughters Kritika and Tarini accepted the honour.
 
• President Ram Nath Kovind presented the prize to the daughters. In December of last year, General Bipin Rawat, India's first Chief of Defence Staff, died in a helicopter crash.
 
• The helicopter disaster also claimed the lives of General Rawat's wife, Madhulika Rawat, and 12 other defence personnel.
 
• Padma Awards, which are among the country's highest civilian honours, are divided into three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• These honours are bestowed by the** President of India** at ceremonial occasions held at Rashtrapati Bhavan every year around March/April.
 
• The President has approved the conferral of 128 Padma Awards this year, including two pair cases (in a duo case, the Award is counted as one). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri **was bestowed on **Guruprasad Mohapatra,** a veteran official recognised for his administrative skills who died of COVID-19 last year.
 
• **Rajiv Mehrishi, the former Comptroller and Auditor General of India**, was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** award in the category of Civil Services at the Rashtrapati Bhawan.
 
• In the field of Trade and Industry, **Natrajan Chandrasekaran** earned the third highest civilian honour, the **Padma Bhushan**.
